description: Whole-board actions. action: 'open' (open a PCB of the project by `name` or uuid, the first one by default), 'import' (bring the schematic's changes onto the board; lists the changes and applies them, apply:false only lists), 'rebuild' (refill all pours), 'autoroute' (EasyEDA's own router; `props` like {RoutingNets:['A','B'], layers:[1,2], ignoreNets:[...]}), 'unroute' (delete all tracks and vias of `net`, or of every net when none is given).
name: pcb_do
